g.text: Small accuracy drops can coexist with disagreement from retraining
60 means per panel: 6 GU methods x 10 request conditions; n = 10 training seeds. Stored f1 = accuracy (micro-F1).
GIF / IDEA coincide (hollow diamonds overlay GIF); no jitter. Reference: one shared GCN Retrain, not within-family retraining.
